contentEn:
A whole house renovation in West Vancouver, BC in 2026 typically costs between $350,000 and $2,000,000 or more, depending on the size of the home, the scope of work, and the level of finish selected. West Vancouver's luxury housing market and hillside terrain mean renovation budgets often run higher than comparable projects in other Metro Vancouver municipalities.

Reno Stars has completed whole-house and multi-room renovation projects in West Vancouver, including kitchen renovations, bathroom renovations and full-interior refreshes. This guide breaks down real 2026 costs so you can budget accurately before signing a contract.

What Does a Whole House Renovation Include in West Vancouver?

A whole house renovation typically covers the interior living spaces: kitchen, all bathrooms, flooring, paint, millwork, electrical updates and lighting, and HVAC improvements. In West Vancouver's older detached homes — many built in the 1970s and 1980s — scope often also includes foundation repairs, drainage improvements for hillside properties, and window replacements to meet current energy codes.

West Vancouver Whole House Renovation Cost by Size

The table below shows typical all-in cost ranges for complete interior renovations in West Vancouver, based on current 2026 pricing and recent Reno Stars project data:

Home SizeTypical ScopeCost Range (2026)
2,000–2,500 sq ftFull interior refresh, 2–3 bathrooms, new kitchen$350,000–$650,000
2,500–3,500 sq ftComplete gut renovation, 3–4 bathrooms, custom kitchen$650,000–$1,100,000
3,500–5,000 sq ftLuxury finishes, 4+ bathrooms, high-end kitchen, HVAC upgrade$1,100,000–$1,800,000
5,000+ sq ftUltra-luxury, structural work, hillside engineering$1,800,000–$2,500,000+

These figures are all-in: materials, labour, permits, project management and HST. Landscaping, pool installations and detached garage work are excluded.

What Drives the Price Up in West Vancouver?

Three factors push West Vancouver renovation costs above comparable Metro Vancouver cities:

  • Hillside terrain and drainage: Many West Vancouver properties sit on slopes requiring engineered drainage solutions, retaining walls or foundation underpinning that add $30,000–$150,000 to a project.
  • Luxury finish expectations: Homeowners typically specify high-end materials — marble countertops, custom millwork, premium flooring — that increase material costs 30–60% over standard finishes.
  • Restricted contractor access: Narrow roads and limited street parking in neighbourhoods like Caulfeild, British Properties and Whytecliff can add logistics costs of $5,000–$20,000.

West Vancouver Permit and Regulatory Costs

Renovations in West Vancouver require a building permit from the District of West Vancouver. Electrical and plumbing work also require separate permits. Typical all-in permit and regulatory costs for a whole-house project range from $8,000 to $25,000, depending on project value and scope. Your Reno Stars project manager will include all permit fees in the initial contract estimate.

How Long Does a Whole House Renovation Take in West Vancouver?

A full interior renovation for a 2,500–3,500 sq ft West Vancouver home typically takes 4 to 9 months. Luxury projects at the higher end of the size range can run 9 to 14 months.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average cost per square foot for a whole house renovation in West Vancouver in 2026?

In West Vancouver in 2026, all-in renovation costs typically range from $175 to $450+ per square foot, depending on finish level and scope. A mid-range complete renovation averages approximately $250–$350/sq ft.

Do I need a structural engineer for a hillside renovation in West Vancouver?

Yes. Properties on slopes in West Vancouver typically require a geotechnical or structural engineer to assess drainage, foundation stability and retaining wall requirements. Engineering fees typically range from $5,000 to $30,000 depending on complexity.

Can I live in my home during a whole house renovation?

For major whole-house renovations, most homeowners choose to relocate during the most disruptive phases — typically the first 6–10 weeks of demo and structural work. Reno Stars works with clients to plan phased timelines that minimise time displaced.

What is the most expensive part of a whole house renovation in West Vancouver?

The kitchen and all bathrooms together typically represent 50–65% of a whole-house renovation budget. Custom cabinetry, high-end stone countertops and premium fixtures are the largest individual line items.

contentZh:
2026年西温哥华整屋装修费用因房屋面积和装修等级不同，通常在35万至200万加元以上之间。西温哥华的豪华住宅市场和山坡地形意味着装修预算通常高于大温其他城市。

聚星装修已在西温哥华完成多项整屋及多房间装修项目，包括厨房装修、浴室翻新及全屋内部改造。本文详细介绍2026年真实装修费用，帮助您在签约前准确预算。

西温哥华整屋装修包括哪些项目？

整屋装修通常涵盖室内生活空间：厨房、所有浴室、地板、油漆、木工及细木制品、电气更新和照明，以及暖通空调改善。西温哥华许多建于1970至80年代的独立屋，装修范围通常还包括地基修复、山坡排水改善和窗户更换，以满足当前的能源规范。

西温哥华整屋装修费用（按房屋面积）

以下表格基于2026年当前定价和聚星装修近期项目数据，显示西温哥华全屋内部装修的典型全包费用范围：

房屋面积典型装修范围2026年费用区间
2,000–2,500平方英尺全屋内部翻新、2–3间浴室、新厨房$350,000–$650,000
2,500–3,500平方英尺全部拆除重装、3–4间浴室、定制厨房$650,000–$1,100,000
3,500–5,000平方英尺豪华装修、4间以上浴室、高端厨房、暖通升级$1,100,000–$1,800,000
5,000平方英尺以上超豪华装修、结构工程、山坡技术要求$1,800,000–$2,500,000+

以上为全包价格：材料、人工、许可证、项目管理和HST。园林绿化、泳池安装和独立车库工程不包括在内。

哪些因素推高西温哥华装修费用？

三个因素使西温哥华的装修费用高于大温其他城市：

  • 山坡地形和排水：许多西温哥华房产位于坡地上，需要工程排水解决方案、挡土墙或地基加固，额外增加30,000至150,000加元。
  • 豪华装修标准：业主通常指定高端材料——大理石台面、定制木工、优质地板——材料成本比标准装修高30至60%。
  • 施工通道受限：Caulfeild、British Properties和Whytecliff等社区的道路狭窄和停车限制，可能增加5,000至20,000加元的物流成本。

西温哥华许可证和监管费用

西温哥华的装修项目需要从西温哥华区获得建筑许可证。电气和管道工程也需要单独的许可证。全屋项目的典型许可和监管总费用在8,000至25,000加元之间，具体取决于项目价值和范围。

西温哥华整屋装修需要多长时间？

西温哥华2,500–3,500平方英尺房屋的全屋内部装修通常需要4至9个月。大型豪华装修项目可能需要9至14个月。
